node.statement: Scalar-header assembly. Using the fixed eta_A,C_A,C_E,epsilon_E, take W_RF to have precisely these four receiving fields; set C_theta=12*(sqrt(2)-1), rho_theta=1/8, rho_AI=eta_A, and define every remaining named scalar in the displayed order (1.1)-(1.8) of def-routef-raw-factor-setting. These formulas are well-defined because C_A=20+(211/8)*12*(sqrt(2)-1)>0, eta_A>0, epsilon_E>0, and bar C_E=max{1,C_E}>=1, so every displayed reciprocal has a positive denominator. Thus this single W_RF is universal and input-independent.
